name: Sakurai Nachi
source:
Position: Butler

A member of the protagonist's team, he's responsible for assisting everyone.
Cooking, laundry, and cleaning, as well as escorting people and disposing of corpses are his jobs.
An energetic and friendly guy.

[spoiler] His real name is Tsukikage Asuka. [/spoiler]
